title: "Final Overflight by Detachment A, 13 October 1957" – route over Kola Peninsula
description: Map titled "Final Overflight by Detachment A, 13 October 1957" showing Norway, Sweden, Finland and the northwestern USSR. A route line with arrows runs "From Wiesbaden" north along the Norwegian coast past Bodo, Narvik and Tromso, then east over the Barents Sea and Kola Peninsula near Murmansk before returning. Includes scale bars, a "Secret NOFORN" marking and handwritten page number "141."
